prompt: 客人說商品壞了，你是客服，想請對方提供訂單編號。
options: Could you please give me your order number?
You must tell me order number.
answer: Could you please give me your order number?

命令句太直接，缺少禮貌用語與冠詞。
must 語氣太強硬，而且 order number 前少了 your。

why: 客服對客人使用 Could you please... 才有禮貌。
tip: 客服請求用 Could you please...
say: Could you please give me your order number?

text: Please send the invoice _____ the accounting department by Friday.

wrong.at: send...at 不通，send 的對象要用 to。
wrong.for: for 表示為了，無法表達寄給某部門。

why: send + 物品 + to + 對象，表示寄給誰。
tip: send sth. to sb.：寄給某人。
say: Please send the invoice to the accounting department by Friday.

prompt: 這封通知的重點是什麼？
text: Due to maintenance, the elevator will be out of service from 9 a.m. to noon on Tuesday.

wrong.週二中午開始維修: 維修與停用是從 9 a.m. 到 noon，不是中午開始。
wrong.電梯永久關閉: 只說某段時間停用，沒有說永久關閉。

why: out of service from 9 a.m. to noon 表示上午這段時間停用。
tip: 通知題抓時間、事件、對象。
say: The elevator will be out of service from 9 a.m. to noon on Tuesday.

text: The manager asked all employees to _____ the new safety rules.

wrong.fellow: fellow 是同伴，拼字相近但不是動詞。
wrong.follows: asked ... to 後面要接原形動詞，不能加 s。

why: ask + 人 + to V，follow the rules 是遵守規則。
tip: ask sb. to + 原形動詞。
say: The manager asked all employees to follow the new safety rules.

prompt: 哪一句寫給客戶的電子郵件開頭最恰當？
options: Dear Ms. Chen, thank you for contacting us.
Hey Chen, thanks for hit us up.
To Chen, I got your message.
answer: Dear Ms. Chen, thank you for contacting us.

Hey 與 hit us up 都太口語，for 後面也應接 V-ing。
稱呼和語氣都不正式，缺少禮貌的感謝。

why: 商務信件用 Dear + 稱謂，並表達感謝。
tip: 商務信：Dear + 稱謂 + 感謝。
say: Dear Ms. Chen, thank you for contacting us.

text: The machine will not start _____ you press the green button first.

wrong.although: although 是雖然，不符合條件關係。
wrong.because: because 是因為，按鈕不是不啟動的原因。

why: unless 表示除非，除非先按綠色按鈕，否則機器不會啟動。
say: The machine will not start unless you press the green button first.

prompt: 在餐廳實習，客人問有沒有素食，你想回答「有，我們有幾道素食料理」。
options: Yes, we have several vegetarian dishes.
Yes, we have several vegetable person dishes.
Yes, we are having vegetarian several dish.
answer: Yes, we have several vegetarian dishes.

wrong.Yes, we have several vegetable person di: vegetable person 不是正確用法，素食的形容詞是 vegetarian。
wrong.Yes, we are having vegetarian several di: have 表示擁有時不用進行式，several 要放在 vegetarian 前並接複數 dishes。

why: vegetarian 是素食的，several 修飾複數名詞 dishes。
say: Yes, we have several vegetarian dishes.

text: All visitors must _____ in at the front desk before entering the building.

wrong.checked: must 後面要接原形動詞，不能用過去式。

why: must + 原形動詞，check in 是辦理報到。
say: All visitors must check in at the front desk before entering the building.

prompt: 下列哪一個是 refund 的意思？
text: We will give you a full refund within seven days.

wrong.維修: repair 才是維修，refund 是退錢。
wrong.折價券: coupon 才是折價券，full refund 是全額退款。

why: refund 指退還款項，full refund 是全額退款。
tip: refund：退款，a full refund 全額退款。
say: We will give you a full refund within seven days.

prompt: 哪一句關於作業安全的警告用法正確？
options: Wear safety glasses when you use this machine.
Wearing safety glasses when you using this machine.
Wear safety glasses when you will use this machine.
answer: Wear safety glasses when you use this machine.

wrong.Wearing safety glasses when you using th: 當警告句時需要祈使句 Wear，且 when 後面應為 use。
wrong.Wear safety glasses when you will use th: when 子句表示時間，用現在式代替未來，不用 will。

why: 祈使句 + when + 現在式，表示在使用機器時要戴護目鏡。
tip: 時間子句用現在式，不用 will。
say: Wear safety glasses when you use this machine.

text: The hotel offers a free _____ service from the airport to the main entrance.

wrong.shuffle: shuffle 是洗牌或拖著腳走，與接駁無關。
wrong.shutter: shutter 是百葉窗，不是接駁服務。

why: shuttle service 是接駁服務，常見於飯店與機場之間。
say: The hotel offers a free shuttle service from the airport.

prompt: 在電話中，你需要請對方稍等。
options: Could you hold the line for a moment, please?
You hang up and call later.
answer: Could you hold the line for a moment, please?

語氣不禮貌，也不像電話用語。
叫對方掛斷，不是請稍等，非常失禮。

why: hold the line 是電話請對方稍候，加 please 更禮貌。
tip: 電話請稍候：Could you hold the line?
say: Could you hold the line for a moment, please?
